def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

P, K = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

if K == 0:
    print(power_mod(P, P - 1, MOD))
elif K == 1:
    print(power_mod(P, P, MOD))
else:
    visited = [False] * P
    cycle_length = 0
    p = 1
    while not visited[p]:
        visited[p] = True
        cycle_length += 1
        p = (K * p) % P
    print(power_mod(P, cycle_length, MOD))
